scripts.build: go tool task build -- "$TARGET" --output "type=local,dest=dist/$TARGET" && go tool task goreleaser -- release --clean --snapshot --verbose --timeout=6h --skip=publish,validate
scripts.check:jsonnet:feature: go tool task jsonnet -- -S --ext-str branch=feature/tooling-check --ext-str target= --ext-str component_ref=example.invalid/group/static-builds/static-release@feature/tooling-check
scripts.check:jsonnet:main: go tool task jsonnet -- -S --ext-str branch=main --ext-str target= --ext-str component_ref=example.invalid/group/static-builds/static-release@main
scripts.check:jsonnet:release: go tool task jsonnet -- -S --ext-str branch= --ext-str target=dnsmasq --ext-str component_ref=example.invalid/group/static-builds/static-release@release-check --tla-str "release_tag=dnsmasq-$(go tool task manifest -- get-official-version dnsmasq).0"
